description: Send Yenta a report: data that is missing or looks wrong, a tool that was hard to use, or anything else. Stored for Yenta's team and never shown publicly; the answer carries a reference. Leave out personal details.

city.description: The city the question was about; a city name only, never an address.

client.description: The app or agent the model runs in.

message.description: The report itself, in plain words.

model.description: The model sending the report, e.g. its model id.

purpose.description: What the person was trying to do, in one short sentence.

subject.description: The venue, destination or city the report is about, if any.

tool.description: The Yenta tool the report is about, if any.

name: send_feedback

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Send feedback to Yenta
